run_musicgen_melody_32khz_explorer: run the MusicGen melody 32kHz grid explorer to launch SLURM training jobs across 32, 64, and 96 GPU configurations
configure_lm_explorer_for_musicgen: configure an LMExplorer decorated function to launch MusicGen training jobs with FSDP and classifier-free guidance settings
launch_cache_generation_jobs: launch 4 cache generation jobs with 1 GPU each to precompute chroma stem features for the music dataset
submit_multi_gpu_training_jobs: submit MusicGen training jobs at 32, 64, and 96 GPU scales with medium and large model configurations
get_slurm_partitions_for_audiocraft: get SLURM partition names for team and global clusters using AudioCraftEnvironment.get_slurm_partitions
